home.answerBlock: Umrah Transport Saudia provides private taxi, SUV, van, and bus hire for Umrah and Hajj pilgrims across Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah. Fares start from 200 SAR. Book instantly via WhatsApp — fixed pricing, no hidden fees, available 24/7.

vehicles.title: Our Fleet
vehicles.subtitle: Private vehicles for every group size — from solo pilgrims to 50-seat delegations.
vehicles.answerBlock: Umrah Transport Saudia operates five vehicle types ranging from a 4-seat Toyota Camry sedan to a 50-seat King Long coach. All vehicles are air-conditioned, privately hired, and driven by professional drivers. Fares start from 200 SAR per trip.

pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Fixed fares — what you see is what you pay.
pricing.answerBlock: All fares below are fixed starting prices in Saudi Riyals (SAR). Final pricing is confirmed when you book via WhatsApp based on your exact route, number of passengers, and journey duration. No meters, no surge fees.
pricing.note: Fares are per trip, not per person. Group bookings are priced on request for multi-day or multi-stop itineraries.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions pilgrims ask before booking.
faq.answerBlock: Below are the most common questions pilgrims ask about booking private transport for Umrah and Hajj in Saudi Arabia. If your question is not covered, message us on WhatsApp.
faq.q1: How do I book a vehicle?
faq.a1: Send us a WhatsApp message at +966 56 913 8258 with your pickup location, destination, date, time, and number of passengers. We confirm availability and fare within minutes.
faq.q2: Are fares per person or per vehicle?
faq.a2: All fares are per vehicle, not per person. A family of 4 pays the same as a solo traveller in the same vehicle type.
faq.a3: Yes. We operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including early Fajr departures and late-night arrivals from King Abdulaziz International Airport.
faq.q4: Can you pick us up from Jeddah Airport?
faq.a4: Yes. Jeddah Airport (King Abdulaziz International Airport) to Makkah is our most booked route. Share your flight number and we will track it for delays.
faq.a5: Yes. We offer transfers between Makkah and Madinah, Jeddah and Madinah, and city transfers within Madinah including the Prophet's Mosque area.
faq.q6: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a6: We accept cash (SAR) on completion of the journey and bank transfer. Payment details are confirmed when you book.
faq.a7: Yes. All drivers hold valid Saudi transport licences and are experienced on Hajj and Umrah routes across the region.
faq.q8: Can I book a vehicle for multiple days?
faq.a8: Yes. Multi-day bookings, Hajj itinerary coverage (Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah), and full-programme transport for groups are all available. Contact us for a custom quote.

about.title: About Umrah Transport Saudia
about.answerBlock: Umrah Transport Saudia is a Makkah-based private transport company specialising in pilgrim transfers across Saudi Arabia. We provide fixed-price, privately hired vehicles — sedan to coach — for Umrah and Hajj travellers from around the world.
about.missionText: Every pilgrim deserves a journey that is calm, comfortable, and free from uncertainty. We exist to remove the stress of ground transport from the Umrah experience — so you can focus entirely on worship.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.answerBlock: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp at +966 56 913 8258. We typically respond within a few minutes. You can also email us or visit our office on Al Hedaya Road, Makkah.
